title: [Decision] Dashboard numbers cannot be opened: should a tile lead to the records behind it?
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

The maintainer: 「等我决定的都要立卡，并且从业务的角度给我具体解释和我沟通」 (2026-11-04). Measured by the seat on `main` `63b86b385d`, on the example CRM unless noted. No `domain:*` label is set: triage routes this card.

## The question

A manager sees 在途商机总额 ¥814,400 and asks which deals make that up. Nothing on the dashboard can be clicked. Reports already drill down (ADR-0021 D2); dashboards do not.

Governing text: ADR-0021 D2 and `ui/packages/plugin-report/src/DatasetReportRenderer.tsx:2181-2182` for reports. `packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.zod.ts` declares header actions and no widget drill.

## Measured

On `pipeline_dashboard`: no links in the page, no click key on any widget, and clicking a tile changes nothing.

## Options

- **A. Tile opens the matching records,** reusing the report drill path, by default where the dataset's filter can be expressed as a list filter.
- **B. A per-widget declared link.**
- **C. Leave it:** open the object's list and rebuild the filter by hand.

## Recommendation: A, after the higher-priority Studio work

## 四轴分析

**实际业务需求。** 看到数字后追问明细，是看板最自然的下一步，经理每周开会都会用。今天要去列表重新设条件，还不一定能和数字对上。

**项目长远合理性。** 报表已经定了下钻做法，复用才不会有两套。要处理不能转成列表筛选的数据集：这种情况不提供点击，不能给出对不上的结果。

**防 AI 写错。** A 不要求作者写任何东西。B 要手写链接和筛选，AI 容易写出和数字对不上的条件。

**创业阶段不扩散。** 能力面中等，不阻塞任何工作，所以排在 #30059 这些之后。

| 棱 | A | B | C |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 业务 | 强 | 中 | 弱 |
| 长远 | 强 | 弱 | 弱 |
| 防错 | 强 | 弱 | 中 |
| 不扩散 | 中 | 中 | 强 |

## Not measured

How many dashboard tiles can be turned into a list filter, and whether period-over-period tiles have a sensible target.

## Re-check

`git grep -n "drillSink" origin/main -- ui/packages/plugin-report/src/DatasetReportRenderer.tsx`
